# Captain Saul

## Overview

- **Age:** 76 years old  <sub>[v4 c8 P63](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0063), [v4 c16 P15](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0015)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v4 c6 P14](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0014)</sub>
- **Status:** Deceased  <sub>[v4 c39 P28](../source/v04-c39.md#nw-v04-c39-p0028)</sub>
- **Role:** Former sea captain and lighthouse keeper  <sub>[v4 c6 P10](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0010), [v4 c9 P0](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0000), [v4 c11 P33](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0033), [v4 c17 P1](../source/v04-c17.md#nw-v04-c17-p0001)</sub>
- **Titles:** Captain  <sub>[v4 c6 P10](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0010)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Captain Saul  <sub>[v4 c6 P10](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0010)</sub>

## Appearance

Captain Saul possessed a tall, somewhat awkward frame that leaned forward slightly while still demonstrating great endurance and strength. He had a thick, shoulder-length mane of iron-gray hair and a closely shaved, bronzed, and heavily furrowed face. His deep-set, blue eyes would alternate between dreaming, twinkling, and gazing out toward the sea.

_Sources: [v4 c6 P14](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0014)_

## Personality

Simple-minded and pure-hearted, Captain Saul possessed an unpretentious, hospitable nature and an everlasting youthfulness in his heart. He maintained a strong delight in beauty, good humor, and a calm, unruffled disposition. He enjoyed philosophical discussions on complex topics and had a tendency to meddle in affairs for worthy causes. Additionally, he was a natural narrator who relished telling stories and sharing laughter with friends.

_Sources: [v4 c6 P14](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0014), [v4 c8 P61](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0061), [v4 c9 P1](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0001), [v4 c9 P5](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0005), [v4 c9 P38](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0038), [v4 c9 P49](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0049), [v4 c14 P3](../source/v04-c14.md#nw-v04-c14-p0003), [v4 c17 P16](../source/v04-c17.md#nw-v04-c17-p0016), [v4 c17 P18](../source/v04-c17.md#nw-v04-c17-p0018)_

## History

Captain Saul spent his youth listening to his mother's seafaring heritage and reading poetry with the local schoolmaster, John Tremayne, before running off to sea. Over fifty years prior, his beloved Margaret was lost in a sudden storm, an event he remembered for the rest of his life. Throughout five decades as a mariner, he sailed across the world, once surviving a shipwreck on the Magdalen Islands and later tracking down a sailor in Havana whom he believed to be Rufus Vane. Five years before his passing, he retired from the sea and took charge of the lighthouse at Seven Gulls Point, choosing to stay there through the winters with his rescued cat, the First Mate. He maintained close friendships with Hugh Carrow and Nell Harcourt, visiting them regularly and participating in late-night philosophical discussions, story sharing, and music playing. With the assistance of Adrian Treleaven, his memoirs were compiled into a volume titled The Life-Book of Captain Saul. In his final spring, his health deteriorated rapidly, and he passed away peacefully shortly before his life-book was printed.

## Background by volume

- Descended from a line of seafaring people on his mother's side  <sub>[v4 c7 P5](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0005)</sub>
- Befriended schoolmaster John Tremayne at sixteen years old  <sub>[v4 c7 P5](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0005)</sub>
- Ran away to sea as a young man and spent five decades at sea  <sub>[v4 c7 P48](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0048), [v4 c8 P63](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0063)</sub>
- Lost his beloved Margaret at sea over fifty years prior  <sub>[v4 c20 P16](../source/v04-c20.md#nw-v04-c20-p0016)</sub>
- Suffered a shipwreck on the Magdalen Islands  <sub>[v4 c32 P12](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0012)</sub>
- Rescued a stray yellow cat, naming him the First Mate  <sub>[v4 c9 P38](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0038)</sub>
- Located Laurence Vane in Havana under the belief he was Rufus Vane  <sub>[v4 c11 P33](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0033), [v4 c32 P12](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0012)</sub>
